name: KPT Industries Limited
about: KPT Industries Limited manufactures electrical power tools and roots, blowers, and exhausters in India and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Portable Power Tools, Blowers, Windmills, and E-vehicles. It offers power tools, such as drills, grinders, hammers. sanders, polishers, tile cutters, saws, broach cutters, planers, trimmers, routers, washers, compressors, concrete vibrators, blowers, heat guns, vacuum cleaners, wrenches, stands, power masters, chainsaws, control motors, and accessories; and welding machines. The company also provides blowers, including root blowers, centrifugal fans, acoustic enclosures, and accessories; e-vehicles comprising e-carts, e-cargos, and e-rickshaws; and agricultural tools consisting of sprayers, mist blowers, bare engines, spray hoses, brush cutters, power weeders, foggers, water pump sets, augers, seeders, chauff cutter, tea garden machines, and horizontal triples pistons. In addition, it is involved in power generation through windmills. The company was formerly known as Kulkarni Power Tools Limited and changed its name to KPT Industries Limited in September 2019. KPT Industries Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kolhapur, India.
